section_summary.extract_value: This section, an abstract and acknowledgements, describes a study by Mar, DeYoung, Higgins, and Peterson that investigates the relationship between self-evaluation measures and self-deception. Across two samples (Study 1 and Study 2), the research found that the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (RSES) and Self-Liking are similar to Self-Deceptive Enhancement, while Self-Competence is uniquely associated with cognitive ability and both academic and creative achievement.
